gap: Nothing changed since r4, and the second image makes it worse. Ours is still a drawing: the hero panel's left third is five blank beige pill bars (a skeleton loader, no module names), the chart is seven flat one-tone rounded rectangles with no axis, no gridlines and no month labels, the right frame edge still severs a bar mid-bar and the STAFF ON LEAVE tile mid-tile, and the 'Languages supported' chip still sits on top of the 'Today's Overview' heading with no pointer tail. The only other product image on the page, the 'Built for every team, in every market' mock, is a fake browser window containing one Arabic greeting line and then eight grey placeholder bars and three empty grey cards, so the one section whose whole claim is 'here is the Arabic UI' shows an empty screen. On mobile the fold carries no product image at all, only headline and URL field, with the 'Languages supported 5' chip clipped by the bottom edge. Wave, by contrast, shows a real Transactions table (Select all checkbox, Filter/Sort/Auto updates chips, Date/Description/Account/Category headers, Nov 12 2025 ATM Check Deposit / Chase Savings, Nov 10 Direct Energy / Preferred Credit Card, CALIFORNIA WATER / Total Checking / Utilities, All Accounts $25,980.23, a cursor mid-hover) and a real dashboard with the sidebar module list legible under the tilt. Every number in Wave's frame is a record a bookkeeper would recognise; not one in ours is. Capture the actual Paper & Pen dashboard and the actual Arabic invoice screen at a scale where sidebar module names and four table rows read, crop so the frame cuts flat chrome only, and give the chips a tail.
